safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts include 'Nil N/V' but do not address 'no unwell contacts'. Since the Gold fact includes both elements, the combined concept is not fully represented.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” removes an exposure-risk element that can influence infectious differential (e.g., COVID/flu) and public health/isolation advice, but it is unlikely to substantially change management in this otherwise uncomplicated URI-style presentation. The “no nausea/vomiting” portion was captured, limiting overall impact.
